import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(transaction_types))
transaction_types.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction Distribution by Hour of Day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hour_counts = data['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax2.plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.fill_between(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Frequency by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Scatter Plot: Amount vs Hour colored by Transaction Type
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax3.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=trans_type, s=150, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Type')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Transaction Type Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("pastel", len(type_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_pie,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 10, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax4.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add summary statistics as text
summary_text = f"Total Transactions: {len(data)}\nFraud Cases: {data['is_fraud'].sum()}\nAvg Amount: ${data['amount'].mean():.2f}"
fig.text(0.02, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=10, 
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
